title: Lilka's crafts
description: This datapack adds crafts for uncraftable items
body:
Maked on Mcreator with my friend

This datapack adds new crafts to uncraftable items. Crafts are balanced. Datapack named after my older sister's cat, Lilka. Thank Lilka for this data pack; she also took part in its development (joke)

You can see crafts on Gallery page, if you playing without Just Enough Items. Screenshots from Mcreator
